name: OIDC Trust Policy Misconfiguration
description: IAM roles can trust OIDC identity providers (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) for federated access. If the trust policy is misconfigured with broad conditions (e.g., only checking aud, or using a wildcard in sub), an attacker can satisfy the conditions from an attacker-controlled repository or identity. The attacker forks a target repo, adds a workflow that requests OIDC tokens, and uses those tokens to assume the role via sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity. No prior AWS credentials needed. The trust policy must allow the attacker's OIDC claims.
